article.title: HighLevel為Managed Agents加入對話排程功能
article.title_en: HighLevel adds conversational scheduling to Managed Agents
article.summary: HighLevel加入Routines，讓使用者以自然語言安排重複任務，結果回到建立任務的對話。
article.summary_en: HighLevel added Routines for recurring tasks described in natural language, with results returned to the originating conversation.
highlights: 每人每個代理最多10項啟用例行工作，最短執行間隔為1小時。
涉及新權限的敏感動作會暫停，付款一律需要批准。
highlights_en: The limit is ten active routines per person per agent, with a one-hour minimum interval.
Sensitive actions needing new permissions pause; payments always require approval.
article.why: 潛在客戶與商機報表可由手動要求改為固定排程，CRM團隊可決定哪些每日檢查需要持續送回同一討論串。
article.why_en: CRM teams can choose which lead and deal checks to schedule into an ongoing discussion.
article.next_step: 先建立一項新客戶及停滯商機摘要，核對首次授權、執行時間及回傳內容，再考慮增加其他例行工作。
article.next_step_en: Start with one new-lead and stalled-deal summary, checking initial permission, timing and returned content.
article.detail: Routines使用已發布的代理版本，每次執行沿用Managed Agents的使用計費。團隊可在專用分頁暫停、恢復及管理權限。合作夥伴的11月20日更新介紹了這項功能，官方變更記錄列明操作規則。郵件通知仍屬後續計劃，現階段應以原對話內的更新作為檢視入口。
article.detail_en: Routines use the published agent version and standard usage billing. A dedicated tab manages pauses, resumption and permissions. A partner's November 20 update introduced the feature, while the official changelog specifies its rules. Email notifications remain planned, so review updates in the conversation.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
